proved: If B=[[b,r^T],[c,D]] is the unpaid O0 double-anchor physical cross block and b!=0, then for S=D-cr^T/b the exact identity Z_ia=b^2 E2(S)>1/768 holds.
The third-minor volume law conditioned on both outer anchors is exactly the second-minor volume law of S; this is deterministic minor-law transport and makes no post-shear independence claim.
If the induced E2 law is heavy on a residual row and column (>2/3 each), then b^2||M||_F^2>1/2304; second anchoring gives either |b|||u||||v||>1/48 or |det physical 2x2 cross minor|*||T||_F>1/48.

partner_result_actually_applied.application: Inside the theorem's exact localized high-window scope, max{|d|,||c||}>tau/9 plus ||c||>|d| implies ||c||>tau/9 and therefore ||p_Q||_infinity<5262.
